use: High-temperature calcination, ignition to constant weight, thermal decomposition.
simulation: Heats by a ramp program; water evaporation, volatilization, thermal decomposition and organic burn-off advance kinetically, and the mass loss can be weighed.
notes: Reference model profile: muffle furnace (Nabertherm L 5/11 class, max 1100 °C). Specs not individually verified (verified = false).
sources: Nabertherm L series product literature (to be archived and checked)
to_calibrate: Lag of sample temperature inside the crucible

start.description: Start heating and hold (runs until stop; write wait_done = false in the plan)

stop.description: Stop heating (furnace cools naturally, ~1 h time constant; take samples only below 100 °C)
